geo.title: What to know
geo.body:
The midterm covers Units 1 to 6. Use the targets below as a checklist: can you do each one without notes?

  • Unit 1 Seeing and Reasoning: Pictures and measurements suggest; only proof convinces.
  • Unit 2 Lines, Angles, and Constructions: A few postulates about rulers and protractors produce reliable theorems about angles.
  • Unit 3 Rigid Motions and Symmetry: Sliding, flipping, and turning keep shape and size.
  • Unit 4 Triangle Congruence: Three well-chosen parts are enough to pin down a triangle.
  • Unit 5 Inequalities and Parallel Lines: Some facts need no parallel postulate; the 180 degree angle sum does.
  • Unit 6 Quadrilaterals and Polygons: Quadrilaterals form a family tree defined by their properties.
